offering_description.value: Sells subscription-based research, advice and data on technology, business and supply chain topics to executives and their teams. Also runs industry conferences and provides consulting and benchmarking. Delivered through analysts, digital platforms and events.

primary_products.value: research subscriptions; benchmarking data and tools; conference tickets

primary_services.value: advisory and analyst inquiry; consulting; conferences and events; peer networking

customer_segment.value: B2B: CIOs, IT leaders, supply chain, marketing, finance, HR executives and technology vendors; B2G: government agencies and public sector organizations

end_markets.value: information technology; supply chain; marketing; finance; human resources; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual research and advisory subscriptions; service fees: conference attendance and sponsorships; project or contract: consulting engagements
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: analyst-produced research and advice sold to enterprise leaders and technology providers

geography_served.value: global: North America, EMEA, Asia-Pacific and Latin America, clients in about 100 countries

specialization.value: related lines: research and advisory, conferences, consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales force selling subscriptions and events to enterprises; online: digital platform and website for research access and event registration

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, data privacy laws and securities rules apply
